title: findings.json
description: Findings written by the agent for one scan. Documentation only: scripts/lib/findings-validate.mjs is the check, and it reports every problem it finds with the finding index and the field to fix. Unknown fields are errors everywhere (additionalProperties is false), so a misspelled field cannot pass silently. A measured finding takes its impact from its measured finding; the validator warns when they differ. A judgment finding is the agent's opinion, and the report says so.

language.description: Language of summary and recommendation. Missing means en. The labels of the report come from templates/labels.<language>.json. Rule ids and titles stay in English.

findings.description: One entry per finding. An empty list is valid: it means the scan found nothing the agent could support.

rule.description: Id of a rule in rules/. The validator rejects an id that is not in the catalog.

axis.description: Must equal the axis of the rule.

kind.description: Must equal the kind of the rule. A measured finding names a measuredFinding; a judgment finding may name the measured findings that support it.

measuredFindingId.description: Only for kind measured, and required there. Must be the id of a measuredFindings entry of measurements.json with the same rule.

measuredSupport.description: Only for kind judgment, optional. Ids of measuredFindings entries of measurements.json that support the judgment. Each must exist; the rule may differ from this finding's rule.

agents.description: Optional. The agents that the finding applies to: ids of agents that the scan detected (agentHarness.agents of measurements.json, such as claude-code or cursor), each named once. The report shows them as Agents. Without this field, the report shows the agents of the measured finding, when it has any (the CTX-07 measure).

evidence.description: Where the finding is. Each file must exist in the target. Paths are relative to the target, with forward slashes; absolute paths, backslashes and .. segments are rejected. The list may be empty when the finding is an absence with no file to cite, as a measured finding can be.

impact.description: Estimated impact. For a measured finding it must equal the impact of its measured finding (the validator warns when it does not).

summary.description: What the finding says. Required and not blank. Any secret-shaped value in it must be masked with mask().

recommendation.description: A change to the harness. Required and not blank.

testInFunction2.description: What to test with the controlled runs of function 2, or null. Required, but its value may be null.

file.description: Path of a file of the target, relative to the target root. With layer, the path of a file outside the target: under ~/.claude/ for user, or beginning with ../ for ancestor.

line.description: First line, counted from 1 as an editor shows it. Without line, the evidence is the file as a whole, and only its existence is checked. Required when quote is given.

endLine.description: Last line of a range. Requires line, and must be at least line and inside the file.

quote.description: Text that must appear on the line (or inside the range), with runs of spaces, tabs and line breaks compared as one space. It must not hold a raw secret, and a masked form does not appear in the file, so for a line that holds a secret, cite the line without a quote. Not allowed with layer, because the validator does not read a file outside the target.

layer.description: Only for a file outside the target. user: a file of the user's Claude folder (~/.claude/), which measurements.json must list under userLayer. ancestor: a file of a parent folder (../), which measurements.json must list in context.ancestors with read true. The validator does not read such a file: line and endLine are checked only against the lines count that measurements.json gives it, and only when it gives one. Without layer, file is a file of the target, as before.
